gopro - waterproof shutter remote for he.description: Get the shot—even when your camera’s out of reach—with the Bluetooth connected Waterproof Shutter Remote. The 1-button design makes it easy to start and stop recording, and it can be mounted anywhere. Mount it to the grip of an extension pole to control your GoPro on the other end, attach it to your bike handlebars to start recording without taking your hands off the bars or conveniently strap it to your wrist when you’re on the go.
